A margin >= 0.01 is a BANKABLE win; a sub-band delta gets the parity phrasing (no band-worship).

H2.text: H-2: the hybrid's post-cooldown row lands at or below the composed machine's own same-seed row (1.3811104467936925 at 3401 / 1.383232252938407 at 3402) -- the slot store pays inside a dense stack even though the pure slot machine lost (the Meta complementarity receipt).

REFUTATION.text: REFUTATION: if the hybrid lands >= pure GDN2's row, the literature's minority-interleave gain did NOT transfer to byte-LM at 150M/20M -- receipt it plainly; the uniformity finding would then extend to the hybrid regime.
